task_brief:
Task: Review the TimelessEchoes forge system and propose concrete improvements (code architecture, maintainability, performance, UX, and testability). Focus on actionable changes and a phased implementation plan.
Constraints:
- Do NOT propose wide refactors across the entire Unity project unless they are clearly justified and can be scoped safely.
- Assume this is an existing shipped/active project: prioritize low-risk, incremental improvements.
- Prefer changes that reduce coupling in UI logic and improve determinism and profiling visibility.
- Where you suggest changes, include specific file/class touchpoints and example code snippets where useful.
Repo root: .
Relevant paths:
- Assets/Scripts/Gear/UI/ForgeWindowUI/ForgeWindowUI.cs
- Assets/Scripts/Gear/UI/ForgeWindowUI/ForgeResultPreview.cs
- Assets/Scripts/Gear/UI/ForgeWindowUI/ForgeIvanXpDisplay.cs
- Assets/Scripts/Gear/UI/ForgeWindowUI/ForgeSlotManager.cs
- Assets/Scripts/Gear/UI/ForgeStatsUIController.cs
- Assets/Scripts/Gear/UI/ConversionPipeline.cs
- Assets/Scripts/UI/TownWindowManager.cs
- Assets/Scripts/Blindsided/SaveData/GameData.cs
- Assets/Scripts/Blindsided/SaveData/StaticReferences.cs
Notes: Primary target is the forge flow (crafting/autocraft, slot selection, results preview, telemetry/stats). Also consider: state management, event lifetimes, allocations/GC, and user feedback/attention indicators.
